story_sequence.text: Code2truth intake must build a source inventory from existing code, docs, skills, tests, CLI behavior, Beacon lighthouse/source-architecture outputs, and available provider artifacts.
Third-party or local code-map providers such as `qi-dev-understand-anything` must be treated as evidence providers only, never as requirement authority.
Intake must reconstruct candidate truth with source refs, confidence, and ambiguity markers for each material claim.
Candidate truth can become formal truth only after user confirmation and governed promotion into the Beacon feature package.
The frozen truth source must be resolver-selected `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md`; generated JSON, legacy triptych, provider graphs, and support research cannot win authority.
`beacon implement` may complete as no-op/evidence-only execution when frozen ACs are already satisfied by existing code and every task has evidence-backed closure.
`tasks.md` must express implementation intent and may mark existing-code satisfaction through evidence refs; it must not fake source churn or replace execution/gate evidence.
`beacon QA` must validate truth-map resolution, package coverage, evidence refs, provider boundary, governance/doctor verification, and current behavior satisfaction.
Ambiguous, stale, conflicting, low-confidence, or unproven behavior must fail closed into questions, exclusions, or change routing instead of freezing as authoritative truth.

The intake model must support a bounded pilot on an existing skill project such as `/Users/apple/Developer/Personal/products/justin-mc-lai-skills`, preferably by one skill pack before whole-repo adoption.
